cues.en: In this video, I'm going to introduce you to a family of techniques called parameter efficient fine tuning, often abbreviated p f.
cues.zh: 這支影片介紹一類稱為參數高效率微調的技術，通常簡稱 PEFT。

cues.en: It is closely related to freezing parameters during training.
cues.zh: 它與訓練時凍結參數密切相關。

cues.en: In fact, most of the p ft methods involve freezing most or all of the trainable parameters in a model.
cues.zh: 事實上，大多數 PEFT 方法會凍結模型中大部分或全部可訓練參數。

cues.en: I am not going to go into a lot of detail about any of the individual techniques, but as a collection, these techniques are worth knowing about.
cues.zh: 我不會深入個別技術的細節，但整體而言，這些技術值得了解，

cues.en: If you plan on fine tuning very large models, and if you don't have access to a lot of computational resources.
cues.zh: 尤其是你打算微調非常大的模型，又沒有大量運算資源的時候。

cues.en: Now, these are not the kinds of methods that you would need for training models with, let's say, 100 million parameters or maybe up to a billion parameters.
cues.zh: 這些方法不是訓練一億個，或最多十億個參數的模型時需要的做法。

cues.en: These methods are really designed for when you are working with very large models on the order of 100 billion parameters.
cues.zh: 它們主要是為了一千億個參數這種規模的超大型模型設計。

cues.en: And it is still the case that you would need at least one and ideally multiple powerful GPUs.
cues.zh: 而且，你仍然至少需要一張，最好是多張強大的 GPU。

cues.en: So it's not like you can use some clever tricks to fine tune a GPT three on a laptop CPU.
cues.zh: 並不是用幾個巧妙技巧，就能在筆電 CPU 上微調 GPT-3。

cues.en: Uh, yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: So as I mentioned, FTX is not one single method, but a family of methods that allow you to fine tune.
cues.zh: 如前所述，PEFT 不是單一方法，而是一整類可用來微調的方法。

cues.en: This is also not something you'd use for pre-training.
cues.zh: 這也不是預訓練時會使用的技術。

cues.en: These are techniques that you would apply to large pre-trained models that you want to fine tune on some narrow task.
cues.zh: 它們用在大型預訓練模型上，針對某個狹窄任務微調。

cues.en: Now maybe that task is generating new text like a chat bot.
cues.zh: 任務可能是像聊天機器人那樣生成新文字。

cues.en: Although the FTX methods tend to work better for simpler and more, uh, well characterized tasks like
cues.zh: 不過，PEFT 方法通常在較簡單、定義較明確的任務上表現更好，例如

cues.en: categorization.
cues.zh: 分類。

cues.en: So the idea is to freeze as many parameters in the model as possible, while training only a small number of parameters.
cues.zh: 概念是盡可能凍結模型中的參數，只訓練少量參數。

cues.en: Some methods involve inserting new layers into a frozen model that can apply some transformation to
cues.zh: 有些方法會在已凍結的模型中插入新層，對資料套用某種轉換，

cues.en: the data that make the frozen pretrained model work better at a specific task.
cues.zh: 讓凍結的預訓練模型更適合特定任務。

cues.en: As I mentioned, the key advantage is that it allows you to fine tune, and if you do not have access
cues.zh: 如前所述，主要優點是即使你沒有足夠的運算能力，

cues.en: to the compute power that you would need to train the entire network.
cues.zh: 無法訓練整個網路，也能進行微調。

cues.en: On the other hand, even doing a forward pass with a 100 billion parameter model can still take several seconds for even just a handful of tokens.
cues.zh: 另一方面，一千億參數的模型即使只做前向傳播，處理幾個詞元也可能要花好幾秒。

cues.en: So limited resources here is really referring to a handful of very powerful GPUs.
cues.zh: 所以這裡所謂資源有限，其實是指只有少數幾張非常強大的 GPU。

cues.en: And you can contrast that with like hundreds or thousands of top of the line GPUs.
cues.zh: 相對的是數百、數千張頂級 GPU。

cues.en: Now, as you can probably imagine, the primary disadvantages of FTX are that it's unlikely that freezing
cues.zh: 你應該能想像，PEFT 主要的缺點是，凍結

cues.en: most of the model and adding a couple of extra parameters here and there is going to give you really better performance than what you would get from a fully trainable, fine tuned model.
cues.zh: 大部分模型，只在各處增加少量參數，通常不太可能比完整可訓練的微調模型表現更好。

cues.en: People often use Peft to train models for specific tasks, like categorizing documents in a particular domain, and that's great for that domain.
cues.zh: 大家常用 PEFT 訓練特定任務，例如某個領域的文件分類；這對該領域很有幫助。

cues.en: It might work really well in that domain, but that trained model with FTX might be difficult to generalize to new tasks because there's always a balance.
cues.zh: 它在該領域可能表現很好，但使用 PEFT 訓練的模型，可能難以泛化到新任務，因為這裡總有取捨。

cues.en: There's a trade off here such that the more narrow and clearly specified the task, the easier and more
cues.zh: 任務越狹窄、定義越明確，

cues.en: successful it will be to fine tune a mostly frozen model, but that does mean that the model is less likely to generalize to new tasks.
cues.zh: 越容易成功微調一個大部分凍結的模型，但也代表模型較不容易泛化到新任務。

cues.en: There are perhaps a dozen specific techniques that fall under the umbrella of Peft.
cues.zh: PEFT 這個大類下面，可能有十幾種具體技術。

cues.en: In this slide, I'm just going to highlight four of them, just to give you a sense of how they work.
cues.zh: 這張投影片只介紹其中四種，讓你了解它們如何運作。

cues.en: So one type of approach is called adapters.
cues.zh: 其中一類稱為 adapter，轉接模組。

cues.en: Here the idea is that you freeze the entire model, but then you add on some additional layers like modules at key locations.
cues.zh: 概念是凍結整個模型，然後在關鍵位置加入額外的層或模組。

cues.en: Many of these adapter modules, these little layers are in between the attention sublayer and the MLP
cues.zh: 許多這類小型 adapter 模組，放在注意力子層與 MLP

cues.en: sublayer, but they can also be placed in between transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 子層之間，也可以放在 Transformer 區塊之間。

cues.en: Then the idea is that these small neural network modules learn some task relevant transformation Formation
cues.zh: 這些小型神經網路模組會學習與任務相關的轉換，

cues.en: without having to change the parameters and the world knowledge that the model has already acquired during pre-training.
cues.zh: 不必更動模型在預訓練時已取得的參數與世界知識。

cues.en: Now, these little added modules actually look like the opposite of an MLP layer, in the sense that
cues.zh: 這些新增的小模組，形狀其實像 MLP 層的相反版本，

cues.en: they tend to be high dimensional at the beginning and at the end, and have one hidden layer in the middle that is low dimensional, plus some non-linearity like aghaloo.
cues.zh: 開頭與結尾維度高，中間的隱藏層維度低，再加上 GELU 之類的非線性。

cues.en: So they actually have an architecture like autoencoders.
cues.zh: 因此，架構有點像自動編碼器。

cues.en: Now, if you are not already familiar with autoencoders, then don't worry, I will describe them later in the course in the section on mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 如果你還不熟悉自動編碼器，不用擔心，後面機制可解釋性的章節會介紹。

cues.en: So that's a little bit about adaptors.
cues.zh: 以上是 adapter 的簡介。

cues.en: There is another set of techniques that relies on low rank decompositions of weights matrices.
cues.zh: 另一類技術，依賴權重矩陣的低秩分解。

cues.en: If you are not super familiar with linear algebra then the idea of a low rank approximation is that
cues.zh: 如果你不太熟悉線性代數，低秩近似的概念，

cues.en: it's a matrix that is smaller than the original matrix, so fewer parameters, and it is like a compressed or an approximated representation of the full matrix.
cues.zh: 就是用一個比原矩陣小、參數較少的矩陣，作為完整矩陣的壓縮或近似表示。

cues.en: So for example, imagine that the attention weights are 1000 by 1000.
cues.zh: 例如，假設注意力權重矩陣是 1000 乘 1000。

cues.en: And now imagine that we can approximate that matrix using a 100 by 100 matrix.
cues.zh: 再假設，我們能用一個 100 乘 100 的矩陣近似它。

cues.en: So that means that instead of having 1 million trainable parameters, we have only 10,000 trainable parameters.
cues.zh: 這表示可訓練參數從一百萬個，減少為一萬個。

cues.en: Of course, the low rank approximation is never perfect.
cues.zh: 當然，低秩近似永遠不會完美。

cues.en: So we are going to lose information.
cues.zh: 所以會損失資訊，

cues.en: We will lose some precision.
cues.zh: 損失一些精確度。

cues.en: But hopefully that information and those details that are lost are not so important for the task we are training on.
cues.zh: 但希望損失的資訊與細節，對我們訓練的任務並不重要。

cues.en: And then the idea is that it's much easier to train 10,000 parameters compared to a million parameters.
cues.zh: 這樣一來，訓練一萬個參數，會比訓練一百萬個容易得多。

cues.en: And of course, that's just for one matrix.
cues.zh: 而且，這還只是一個矩陣。

cues.en: If you repeat this for lots of weights matrices throughout the model, this can really add up.
cues.zh: 如果對模型中的許多權重矩陣都這麼做，節省就會很可觀。

cues.en: So Laura and Dora are two specific methods that fall within the category of training low rank approximations
cues.zh: LoRA 與 DoRA，就是這一類方法中的兩種，訓練的是透過矩陣分解得到的低秩近似，

cues.en: based on matrix decompositions instead of the full weights matrices.
cues.zh: 而不是完整的權重矩陣。

cues.en: Next, I will tell you about the idea of a prefix module.
cues.zh: 接著介紹 prefix module，也就是前綴模組。

cues.en: Here the idea is to freeze the entire model and then add another layer before the embeddings at the
cues.zh: 概念是凍結整個模型，再於模型開頭的嵌入之前

cues.en: beginning of the model, which you actually do train on your specific task.
cues.zh: 加入一層，只針對你的特定任務訓練這一層。

cues.en: And then this prefix module will learn how to transform your tokens into like modified embedding vectors that are optimized for your specific task.
cues.zh: 這個前綴模組會學習，如何把詞元轉成經過修改、針對特定任務最佳化的嵌入向量。

cues.en: Ask.
cues.zh: 也就是針對該任務。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then the last approach that I will mention is to freeze all of the weights in the model and train all of the bias terms.
cues.zh: 最後一種方法，是凍結模型的所有權重，只訓練全部偏置項。

cues.en: Here, the idea is that there are relatively few bias terms compared to the weights, and so it is easier to train them.
cues.zh: 因為偏置項比權重少得多，所以比較容易訓練。

cues.en: Now the bias terms can be quite powerful in models, although mostly their impact is to shift around distributions.
cues.zh: 偏置項在模型中可以有很大作用，不過主要影響通常是平移分布。

cues.en: They have less impact over reshaping the spaces in which the embeddings are represented.
cues.zh: 對於重塑嵌入所表示的空間，影響相對較小。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So these are certainly not all of the FFT techniques, but other techniques that you will come across are going to be somehow related to these ideas.
cues.zh: 這當然不是所有 PEFT 技術，不過你遇到的其他技術，通常也會與這些概念有關。

cues.en: I am not going to discuss any more specific mathematical or implementational details about these methods,
cues.zh: 我不會進一步討論這些方法的數學或實作細節，

cues.en: but there are several libraries and functions in Python that people have written to implement these techniques.
cues.zh: 但 Python 已有一些函式庫和函數，用來實作這些技術。

cues.en: This screenshot here shows the Huggingface website about Beft.
cues.zh: 這張截圖是 Hugging Face 的 PEFT 網站。

cues.en: It is certainly not the case that you can only use these methods through hugging face, but it is the
cues.zh: 當然，不是只有透過 Hugging Face 才能使用這些方法，但如果

cues.en: case that if you are downloading and using a pre-trained model from hugging face, then it is convenient
cues.zh: 你本來就從 Hugging Face 下載並使用預訓練模型，

cues.en: to use their library for methods.
cues.zh: 使用他們的函式庫來套用這些方法，就很方便。

cues.en: Okay, so the key take home points here are basically just reiterating what I said in the beginning of the lecture.
cues.zh: 好，重點基本上是重申這堂課一開始說的內容。

cues.en: These methods are never really going to be as good as fully fine tuning a model, but they can work
cues.zh: 這些方法終究不會像完整微調模型那麼好，但如果任務

cues.en: quite well if you have a task that is easy to quantify in terms of a loss function, and less kind of
cues.zh: 很容易用損失函數量化，仍然可以有不錯的效果；相較之下，

cues.en: open and difficult to evaluate, like generating text on a wide range of topics.
cues.zh: 跨廣泛主題生成文字這種開放、難以評估的任務，就比較不容易。
